name: ue5-mcp
description: Server-agnostic field manual for AI agents driving Unreal Engine 5.7 / 5.8 through MCP. Engine-level reflection gotchas, crash patterns, subsystem-specific quirks (Niagara, MetaSound, Materials, Lumen, UMG, audio), the Python-to-MCP data channel workaround, transport requirements, and verify-after-mutate patterns. Works with any MCP server that exposes UE5 functionality — Epic's official ModelContextProtocol plugin, custom servers, or anything else.
